full_name: Magda Teter | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2007–2008 History Emeline Bigelow Conland Fellow Wesleyan University
bio: Magda Teter, an associate professor of history at Wesleyan University, is a scholar of early modern religious and cultural history, Jewish-Christian relations in particular.
